Senior Backend Engineer (Payouts)
Acme Payments · Berlin or remote (EU)

About the role
You will own the services that move money from marketplaces to sellers: payout scheduling, our double-entry ledger, and bank integrations.

What you'll do
- Design and build reliable, idempotent payout APIs in Go
- Evolve our PostgreSQL ledger schema and keep it correct under concurrency
- Mentor junior engineers through code review and pairing
- Write clear design docs and share them asynchronously

Requirements
- 5+ years building backend services in production
- Strong Go or Java experience
- Deep knowledge of PostgreSQL, including transactions and isolation levels
- Experience designing distributed systems that handle failures gracefully
- Excellent written communication

Nice to have
- Experience in payments or fintech
- Kafka or another event streaming platform
- Familiarity with PCI DSS is a plus
